findings.sourceReading: The source concludes by reaching the Golden Land. CH16 explains 郷 read as kyou, then 京 interpreted as kei (10^16), one tenth giving quadrillion. findings.alternative: The English adaptation coordinates its altered epitaph with a solvable English mechanism. This explains the editorial choice but does not preserve the source clue, Rosa theory, or narrated arithmetic; it is one connected adaptation rather than multiple independent defects.
